qwen3.6:35b-a3b.name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B — speed/context option (MoE ~3B active, fast, VRAM-lean)

devstral:24b.name: Devstral 24B — agentic alternative (dense, clean multi-file diffs)
devstral:24b.//: Was the default for tool-call reliability; still excellent, but ~2x the KV-cache cost of the MoEs.

code:opencode.name: Qwen3-Coder 64k — dedicated coder distil (older gen, still solid)

gemma4:31b-it-qat.name: Gemma 4 31B — you wanted to test this (chat/plan)

gemma4-code:64k.name: Gemma 4 31B @ 64k — test it as a coding driver
